sources.title: Wikipedia: Origen
sources.description: Christian scholar, ascetic, and theologian (c. 185 – c. 253)

notes.text: Origen of Alexandria, also known as Origen Adamantius, was an early Christian scholar, ascetic, and theologian who was born and spent the first half of his career in Alexandria.
Origen was a prolific writer who wrote roughly 2,000 treatises in multiple branches of theology, including textual criticism, biblical exegesis and hermeneutics, homiletics, and spirituality.
Origen was one of the most influential and controversial figures in early Christian theology, apologetics, and asceticism.
Origen is remembered as a philosopher connected with Egypt.
Origen's recorded life dates place this profile around 185-254.
